title: task_state
description: Where a Task stands: queued, active, completed, failed, cancelled, or undelivered. The Asset's reports move it, and only forward: queued, active, then one final state (completed, failed or cancelled), which never changes. undelivered is the one state Core sets, for a Task it gave up delivering (dropped unsent, or never shown before the Asset went offline). It is not final: a later report from the Asset replaces it.
